title: Oversight - Continuing Discussion about the Risks Posed by Artificial Intelligence
location: Council Chambers, City Hall, New York, NY

oversight_topic.name: Oversight - Continuing Discussion about the Risks Posed by Artificial Intelligence

transcription.keyterms: hearings/2026-10-16-technology-ai/lexicon.txt (14 terms, sources in the file); BetaNYC's organization list not used.
transcription.turn_merge_rule: Consecutive Deepgram segments merged into one turn when they share a speaker cluster and the gap between them is under 5 seconds.
transcription.runs: Run 2 is published. Run 1 (2026-10-19) used BetaNYC's organization list, which put a staff name in place of the SpaceX witness's self-introduction; its files are kept outside the repo as *-run1-core-lexicon.*

context.text: The committee report states that SpaceXAI was issued a subpoena to provide testimony before the City Council but did not appear during the Committee of the Whole's hearing on October 5, 2026; that SpaceXAI afterwards reached out to the Council and agreed to provide testimony at this October 16 hearing; and that the Committee expected testimony from SpaceXAI and other interested parties.
context.source: Committee Report, T2026-2684, Committee on Technology, October 16, 2026, Introduction (Legistar attachment, last modified 2026-10-15), legistar/t2026-2684-committee-report.docx

council_members_present_source: From the speaker labels (who is heard on the recording), not the committee roster; members who attended without speaking are not listed. Carmen De La Rosa chairs the Committee on Technology (Legistar).
naming_sources: self-introductions, the chair calling on people, Zoom name labels read from video frames, the Council's own captions, and voice clusters
witness_spelling: Witness names follow the Zoom name label where one was shown on screen, and otherwise the transcription. The SpaceXAI witness is "Gabriela Castillo Madrid" as her Zoom tile showed it; the Council's captions have "Gabriella Madrid" at her self-introduction and "Christina Madrid" when counsel called her. Names have not been checked against a witness list or written testimony; corrections are welcome as GitHub issues.
known_gaps: Qiaojing Ella Zheng is labeled "counsel to Devin Kim". She named her law firm, but the transcription and the captions disagree on its name, so no firm is given.
The word lists for this hearing's word clouds were not reviewed by hand. They reuse the stopwords made for the 2026-10-05 hearing, so some filler (for example "obviously", "asked") remains.
